span.label: The moment estimates start at zero, so early estimates are biased toward zero; the correction divides by one minus the decay rate raised to the timestep.
span.term: initialisation bias from zero-initialised moving averages
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: As an optimum is approached the ratio falls, so the effective step shrinks with no schedule imposed.
span.term: automatic annealing via the signal-to-noise ratio
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Rescaling the gradient by c scales the first moment by c and the second by c squared, and the two cancel in the ratio.
span.term: invariance of the update to gradient rescaling
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The convergence analysis covers only convex objectives, not the non-convex problems on which Adam is mostly used.
span.note: what this limits: the convergence guarantee, which does not cover the setting the method is used in: Quotation withheld

span.label: The Lp-norm generalisation of the update rule is numerically unstable except in the infinity-norm limit.
span.note: what this limits: the Lp-norm generalisation of the update rule: SUCH VARIANTS BECOME NUMERICALLY UNSTABLE FOR LARGE p, leaving the infinity-norm limit as the usable case
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: In convolutional nets the second moment estimate vanishes and poorly approximates the cost surface.
span.note: what this limits: convolutional networks specifically: THE SECOND MOMENT ESTIMATE IS THEREFORE A POOR APPROXIMATION TO THE GEOMETRY OF THE COST FUNCTION IN CNNs
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: On the CNN experiment the gain over SGD with momentum is only marginal.
span.note: what this limits: the size of the advantage on the CNN experiment: THOUGH ADAM SHOWS MARGINAL IMPROVEMENT OVER SGD WITH MOMENTUM, IT ADAPTS LEARNING RATE SCALE FOR DIFFERENT LAYERS
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AdaGrad —is-a→ Adam
span.note: strength of the relation: 0.7 — A LIMITING-CASE MEMBERSHIP, typed `is-a` not `same-as` because the span says 'corresponds to a version of', not that the two are the same thing. The paper scopes it itself one sentence later: the correspondence 'does not hold when removing the bias-correction terms'. Schema 0.3 has nowhere to put that scope - `holds_for` in NOTES/SCHEMA_04_PROPOSAL.md. Filing it in `differs_in` would mis-state a scope as an axis.
